question: Should this stay in ClawHub as a concrete registry/package API gap, or be routed to the OpenClaw runtime or Feishu plugin as the owner of channel pairing state?
rationale: Current ClawHub main does not contain the failing command or pairing state, so automation cannot choose the owning subsystem without maintainer direction.

options.title: Route to runtime/plugin triage
options.body: Keep this issue open or transfer it with a request for requester and approver logs, OpenClaw version, and WSL/NAT details before changing ClawHub.

options.title: Define a ClawHub API gap
options.body: If runtime triage proves pairing depends on missing catalog or package APIs, create a focused ClawHub task with the exact endpoint or metadata contract to add.

options.title: Close as external support
options.body: If maintainers confirm the failure is wholly outside this repository, close with the correct support or runtime-plugin destination.

recommendation.title: Route to runtime/plugin triage
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open or transfer it with a request for requester and approver logs, OpenClaw version, and WSL/NAT details before changing ClawHub.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest current evidence trail across ClawHub CLI/package/auth surfaces and the adjacent CLI taxonomy discussion.
